<!--

Discrete "coin toss" example

```{r}

avg_height <- 69

sim_heights <- c()

# There are 4 genes. 2 genes make you tall, and 2 genes make you short. Each gene is responsible for 5 inches. You are the tallest if you get 2 tall genes and no short genes, and the shortest if you get 2 short genes and no tall genes.

for (i in 1:500){
    gene1 <- sample(c(0,5), size=1)
    gene2 <- sample(c(0,5), size=1)
    gene3 <- sample(c(0,-5), size=1)
    gene4 <- sample(c(0,-5), size=1)
    error <- gene1 + gene2 + gene3 + gene4
    sim_heights[i] <- avg_height + error
}

hist(sim_heights)

```

-->
